note: Set A binds most values to the correct series and location (e.g., Irvine Avg. High 84 F in August, Louisville Avg. Mean 77 F in July, Avg. Low 28 F in December), though it has a few misreads (Louisville red-line February 56 F, March high 67 F, June low 55 F, July high 84 F duplicating/conflicting with its own 88 F) and three vague 'Bowman Field temperature' claims with no series named. Set B is weaker: it contains direct internal contradictions on the same chart (Avg. Low January 22 F vs 40 F, Avg. Low December 40 F vs 28 F, Avg. Mean January 35 F vs 54 F) and seven claims whose entity is only 'Temperature Series 1/2/3 (Yellow/Red/Brown)' with attribute 'value', which never binds the reading to a location or property. Both sets read values off plotted lines rather than stated text, but A keeps the Avg. High/Mean/Low naming and month conditions consistently and errs less often.
